PORT.description: HTTP port inside this service. Keep the default to match its Railway public port and health check.

PLIKD_PLIK_DOMAIN.description: Plikd plik domain resolved automatically from the linked service. Keep this reference when using the included topology.

PLIKD_MAX_FILE_SIZE_STR.description: Plikd max file size str for plik. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

RAILWAY_DOCKERFILE_PATH.description: Repository-relative Dockerfile used to build this service. Keep the supplied path.

PLIKD_DEFAULT_ADMIN_LOGIN.description: Plikd default admin login for plik. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

PLIKD_FEATURE_LOCAL_LOGIN.description: Plikd feature local login for plik. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

PLIKD_DEFAULT_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Generated plikd default admin password. Keep private and preserve with backups.

PLIKD_FEATURE_AUTHENTICATION.description: Plikd feature authentication for plik. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.
